plan.sync: Plan synced to the payment provider successfully.

subscription.assign: Plan assigned to the workspace successfully.
subscription.credit: Tokens credited to the workspace successfully.

error.planSlugExist: A plan with this slug already exists.
error.planSyncFailed: Plan saved, but syncing it to the payment provider failed.
error.planIsSystem: This is a system plan and cannot be archived.
error.subscriptionProviderManaged: A payment provider bills this subscription, and this change cannot go through it. Cancel the subscription first.
error.subscriptionNotResumable: This subscription has no scheduled cancel to undo.
error.planInactive: This plan is not on sale.
error.planInUse: {live} workspace(s) are subscribed to this plan, so its price, currency and billing cycle cannot change. Create a new plan instead.
error.checkoutUnavailable: Checkout is not available with this payment provider right now.
error.planNotPurchasable: This plan cannot be bought with this payment provider.
error.subscriptionAlreadyPaid: This workspace already has a paid subscription. Change its plan instead of checking out again.
error.providerRequestFailed: The payment provider refused the request. Nothing was changed.
